# Thinkel — daily quotes (PWA)
# https://thinkel.labram.workers.dev

> Thinkel is a free, installable web app (PWA) that shows one thought-provoking quote a day, in English or Slovenian. Readers can save favourite quotes, write private thoughts about them, generate 9:16 wallpaper images from quotes, and use the app offline. No account, no tracking, no ads.

Thinkel is made by Lovro Abram (Instagram: @abram.lovro) as a companion to his daily short-video project about Jesus and the Bible. The quote library currently holds 47 quotes per language; a date-based hash selects the quote of the day, so every calendar day shows the same quote for everyone and the rotation refreshes after 47 days.

## Pages

- [Home — quote of the day](https://thinkel.labram.workers.dev/): today's quote with actions to share it, save it as a 9:16 image, favourite it, or write a private thought about it.
- [Saved](https://thinkel.labram.workers.dev/saved): the user's locally stored favourite quotes and written notes, with search. Content stays in the browser (localStorage), nothing is uploaded.
- [Settings](https://thinkel.labram.workers.dev/settings): quote font size, app language (English or Slovenian), data backup export/import (.thinkel file), app installation.
- [Wallpaper Editor](https://thinkel.labram.workers.dev/wallpaper): upload any photo, add a quote on top, choose font, size, colour and alignment, and export a 9:16 phone wallpaper.

## Notes for LLMs

- The app is fully client-side (static HTML/CSS/JS + service worker); user data (favourites, notes, settings) never leaves the device.
- Quote data lives in `data/en.citati.json` and `data/sl.citati.json` (fields: id, text, author, category, tags).
- Supported languages: English (default) and Slovenian (auto-detected from the browser, switchable in Settings).
- Thinkel lives at https://thinkel.labram.workers.dev (a subdomain sibling of the author's main site https://website.labram.workers.dev — that one hosts his 30-day video journey; Thinkel is the daily-quote companion app).
